description: This file defines the core agent logic for the AgentField SDK, including registration of reasoners, HTTP handlers for health, discovery, execution, and reasoner endpoints, context management, communication with the AgentField control plane, and integration with AI services. It manages both server and serverless modes, handles asynchronous status reporting, and supports internal reasoner invocation.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Captures the context information sent with each execution, such as IDs, session info, reasoner name, start time, and hierarchy tracking.

classes.name: Reasoner
classes.description: Represents a handler logic or skill, along with associated schemas, CLI access, and description.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for setting up the agent, including node identifiers, URLs, tokens, AI settings, and lease management.

classes.name: CLIConfig
classes.description: Specifies CLI presentation, help text, environment variables, and output format options.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: Main struct managing registration, HTTP handling, reasoning logic, communication with control plane, and auxiliary features like AI and memory.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructs a new Agent instance with provided configuration, initializing clients and internal state.

methods.name: RegisterReasoner
methods.description: Registers a new reasoner (handler or skill) with optional configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Registers the agent node with the control plane without starting the server.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Decides whether to serve HTTP or run CLI based on arguments and configuration.

methods.name: Serve
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server, registers with control plane, handles shutdown signals.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Runs a specific reasoner by name with provided input.

methods.name: HandleServerlessEvent
methods.description: Handles external serverless platform events, normalizing inputs and invoking reasoners.

methods.name: Call
methods.description: Invokes another reasoner via the control plane, preserving execution context.

methods.name: CallLocal
methods.description: Directly invokes a local reasoner within the same node, maintaining execution lineage.

methods.name: AI
methods.description: Performs an AI/LLM completion request with specified prompt and options.

methods.name: AIStream
methods.description: Streams a response from an AI/LLM, providing chunks and errors.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Provides access to the agent's hierarchical memory storage.
